record.note: 3-1 under HC Jesse Minter after beating the Tennessee Titans 24-18 at home (2026-10-04). Next up: Week 5 on the road at the Atlanta Falcons (2026-10-11, SNF). QB Lamar Jackson (left ankle sprain) is officially OUT — ruled out by HC Jesse Minter on Friday 10/9 after not practicing all week; Tyler Huntley will make his ~12th career start in relief. OLB Trey Hendrickson (finger) is also officially OUT. WR Zay Flowers (foot) and CB Marlon Humphrey (hamstring/calf) are both Questionable. The market line has drifted slightly further toward Atlanta as Jackson's absence firmed up: Fox Sports (2026-10-09, 13:32 UTC) has Falcons -173/Ravens +146, spread Falcons -3.5, total 43.5 (vs. -160/+156 on 10-08) — the spread/total have held steady at -3.5/43.5 all week. TE Durham Smythe (Achilles) remains out for the season (placed on IR 10/7). Update 2026-10-11 (pregame): no official inactives yet (post ~90 min before the 8:20pm ET kickoff); Flowers/Humphrey remain only Questionable as of Friday. Market line essentially unchanged from Friday (Falcons -173 to -182 / Ravens +144 to +156 across books, spread -3.5, total 43.5 -- normal weekend vig movement, not a real shift).

coaching_change.headline: New head coach for 2026: Jesse Minter (4th HC in franchise history), replacing John Harbaugh after 18 seasons.
details: New special teams coordinator: Anthony Levine Sr.
Updated 2026-09-09: Minter named five permanent captains for 2026 — Lamar Jackson (QB), Derrick Henry (RB), Roquan Smith (ILB), Kyle Hamilton (S), Calais Campbell (DL).

Updated 2026-09-15: Minter picked up his first career win as a head coach in the Week 1 blowout at Indianapolis (41-23), notably played near his hometown of Yorktown, Indiana — greeted postgame by his family, including his father Rick, also on the Ravens coaching staff.

Updated 2026-09-17: Thursday practice report ahead of Week 2 vs. New Orleans (9/20) — WR Zay Flowers (hamstring), LT Ronnie Stanley (toe), and LG John Simpson (groin) did not practice; OLB Trey Hendrickson (hand) and CB T.J. Tampa (knee) limited. Roster moves: K Jake Moody released after Tyler Loop's strong Week 1 kicking; WR Chris Moore re-signed to the 53-man roster.

Updated 2026-09-18: Friday's final Week 2 injury report brought several downgrades — DT Nnamdi Madubuike (neck) and ILB Teddye Buchanan (knee) both upgraded from Limited to OUT; CB T.J. Tampa (knee) did not practice and was ruled OUT. WR Devontez Walker (groin) and S Keondre Jackson (shoulder) were upgraded to full practice, trending toward playing. OLB Trey Hendrickson (finger) and G John Simpson (groin) remain Questionable (Limited again Friday).

Updated 2026-09-19: WR Zay Flowers (hamstring), Doubtful after Friday's Limited practice, was downgraded further to OUT for Week 2 as a caution — team and reports (Ian Rapoport) describe it as not serious. Ravens also elevated OT Gerad Christian-Lichtenhan from the practice squad; reporters (ESPN's Jamison Hensley, The Athletic's Jeff Zrebiec) read this as a bad sign for Ronnie Stanley's toe injury — if Stanley sits, rookie Carson Vinson would start at left tackle, a tough early test against Saints EDGE Chase Young.

Updated 2026-09-21: Minter's Week 2 postgame/weekly press conference (his first loss as a head coach) — defended the failed 3rd-and-1 call, called penalties a "major point of emphasis," and cited third-down defensive breakdowns (coverage leverage, unabated pressure, missed tackles on checkdowns). Said the team has "a good shot with a lot of guys this week" (WR Zay Flowers, OT Ronnie Stanley, DT Nnamdi Madubuike all trending toward playing Week 3; final call expected Wednesday 9/23). ILB Trenton Simpson praised as "playing like one of our best players"; WR Rashod Bateman stepped up with Flowers out; CB Chidobe Awuzie flagged as needing more snaps. WR Ja'Kobi Lane placed on IR (wrist surgery) — out for the season. Attention now turns to the Week 3 trip to Rio de Janeiro to face Dallas.

Updated 2026-09-24 (Wed 9/23 practice report, latest official): DT Nnamdi Madubuike (neck) and ILB Teddye Buchanan (knee) both returned to FULL practice — trending toward their season debuts vs. Dallas. WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) and OT Ronnie Stanley (toe) both DID NOT practice Wednesday — still day-to-day and not yet cleared, a softer status than earlier in the week suggested (no Friday report out yet). OLB Trey Hendrickson (finger) DNP but played through it vs. the Saints in a cast and recorded his first sack; G John Simpson (groin) remains Limited. CB T.J. Tampa (knee) is off the injury report entirely. New names appearing Wednesday: DL Calais Campbell (DNP, appears to be a scheduled rest day after 40 snaps vs. Saints, not a new injury), WR Chris Moore (ankle), S Malaki Starks (hamstring), OLB Zion Young (quad) — all Limited. Minter flagged 12 penalties for 90 yards through 2 games as a point of emphasis; ILB Trenton Simpson again drew praise (6 tackles, 1 TFL vs. Saints). Team practices Wed/Thu in Baltimore, flies out Thursday night for Sunday's game at Maracanã Stadium in Rio; NFL confirmed no concerns about field conditions. Dallas also banged up: LB Demarvion Overshown, CB Cobie Durant, S P.J. Locke, S Malik Hooker all out/questionable. Market line moved toward Baltimore since 9/22: FanDuel now Ravens -178/Cowboys +150, spread Ravens -3.5 (was -158/+134, -3).

Updated 2026-09-30: Ravens beat the Cowboys 34-31 in Rio de Janeiro (2026-09-27) to improve to 2-1; Ronnie Stanley (toe) was ruled out and rookie Carson Vinson made his first career start at left tackle, while Nnamdi Madubuike, Zay Flowers, and Teddye Buchanan were full-strength participants. No new post-game injury or transaction news has surfaced as of today; a formal Week 4 injury report (vs. Tennessee Titans, 2026-10-04) had not yet been published as of this refresh — those typically post Wed/Thu of game week.

Updated 2026-10-02 (Wed/Thu Week 4 practice reports ahead of Sunday's game vs. Tennessee Titans): Lamar Jackson appeared on the injury report with a back issue, limited Wednesday but full Thursday — HC Jesse Minter called it "minor," no game designation attached, expected to play. Zay Flowers (hamstring) and Marlon Humphrey (hamstring) both upgraded to full practice Thursday and are trending to play. Nnamdi Madubuike (neck) and Teddye Buchanan (knee) are off the injury report entirely — appear fully healthy. Ronnie Stanley (toe) remained limited both days, still not a full clearance. New/notable: center Jovaughn Gwyn is reportedly facing a multi-week absence (a fractured fibula per one report), and primary backup center Ethan Pocic (knee) did not practice either day — a concern given Danny Pinter is already out for the season at that position. Trey Hendrickson (OLB) did not practice with a reported multi-fracture finger injury, pending a Friday status call. No official Friday (final) game-status designations had posted as of this refresh — only Wed/Thu practice-participation data was available. Sourcing: Yahoo Sports, RoundTable.io, ClutchPoints, SharpFootballAnalysis roundup (all dated 2026-10-01/02); treat as moderate confidence pending the final injury report.

Updated 2026-10-04 (official Friday injury report, via baltimoreravens.com, ahead of today's 1:00pm ET kickoff vs. Tennessee Titans): Lamar Jackson (back) and Marlon Humphrey (hamstring) both logged full practice all week and carry no game designation — cleared to play. Zay Flowers (hamstring) and Ronnie Stanley (toe) are QUESTIONABLE (Flowers was limited Friday after two full days; Stanley did not practice Friday after two limited days). Trey Hendrickson (OLB, finger) and Ethan Pocic (C, knee) are both OUT after DNP all three practice days. Center Jovaughn Gwyn is also OUT, now listed on the official report with an ankle designation (differs from the earlier-reported fractured-fibula characterization — treat the exact injury detail as unconfirmed, but the practical out-this-week status is consistent across sources). Official inactives list had not yet posted as of this refresh (standard ~90 minutes before kickoff).

Updated 2026-10-07: new development since the win over Tennessee — Lamar Jackson suffered a LEFT ANKLE SPRAIN late in that game (10/4) when a Titans defender landed on him; he left in a protective boot, had an MRI Monday 10/6, and HC Jesse Minter was noncommittal on his status for Sunday's game at Atlanta: "I really don't think it's going to be crazy long-term, but we'll see what happens" (quotes via Newsweek, Field Level Media). Backup Tyler Huntley (8/9 for 63 yds in relief vs. Tennessee) would start if Jackson sits. No Wednesday practice-participation report had posted as of this refresh (checked multiple sources) — the official word is expected Thursday/Friday. Everything else (Gwyn/Pocic on IR, Vega Ioane at center, Hendrickson's finger, Flowers' hamstring) is unchanged from the 10-05 update.

Updated 2026-10-08 (official Wednesday 10/7, 1:53pm ET practice report, via baltimoreravens.com): Lamar Jackson (left ankle sprain) DID NOT PRACTICE; HC Jesse Minter said his Sunday availability will be "evaluated during the week" — still no game-status designation, with Thursday/Friday reports the next real signal (backup Tyler Huntley would start if Jackson sits). Also DNP Wednesday: Marlon Humphrey (hamstring/calf), Ronnie Stanley (rest/toe/ankle), Trey Hendrickson (finger, post-procedure), Calais Campbell (rest), Andrew Vorhees (foot). Limited: Kyle Hamilton (groin), John Simpson (groin), Zay Flowers (foot), Rashod Bateman (shoulder), Chris Moore (ankle). Roster move: TE Durham Smythe placed on IR (Achilles) — new. Market line flipped to Atlanta favored this refresh (see record note) — plausibly tied to Jackson's continued absence from practice.

Updated 2026-10-10 (official Friday 10/9 injury report/game-status designations, via NFL.com, ClutchPoints, Yardbarker): Lamar Jackson (left ankle sprain) officially ruled OUT for Sunday — Tyler Huntley will start (his ~12th career start); one report (Yardbarker) flagged the injury as possibly a multi-week issue. Trey Hendrickson (finger) also officially OUT, still recovering from his finger procedure. Zay Flowers (foot) and Marlon Humphrey (hamstring/calf) both Questionable. Andrew Vorhees (foot) also Questionable (depth-piece, not modeled). Jovaughn Gwyn and Ethan Pocic remain out long-term (IR) with Vega Ioane at center. No new injuries, transactions, or coaching news found beyond the injury-report finalization.

Updated 2026-10-11: Ravens traded a 2027 5th and 2028 2nd to the Philadelphia Eagles for two-time Pro Bowl center Cam Jurgens on 2026-10-07 (also receiving a 2027 7th back), after three O-line centers (Danny Pinter, Jovaughn Gwyn, Ethan Pocic) landed on IR and forced 1st-round rookie G Vega Ioane into emergency center duty. Jurgens is in the concussion protocol and is NOT expected to debut tonight vs. Atlanta -- targeting a Week 6 (at Cleveland, 10/18) return. Also signed TE Nick Vannett to the 53-man roster (2026-10-07) for added depth with Durham Smythe now on IR (Achilles, placed 10/6-10/7).
